name: Face-tracked puppet
summary: A rendered 3D head that copies the face of the user in real time through a depth camera.
how: Read the face with a depth camera and map 50 muscle movements to head controls.
Render the head at 60 fps with soft light and a contact shadow.
Limit a recorded clip to 10 seconds.

origin.note: Apple releases Animoji with the iPhone X and its TrueDepth camera.

adoptions.via: Animoji and later Memoji turn the face of the user into a rendered mask in messages and video.
